cause: The System Alerts menu is anchored to the end edge of the bell button, and its 340px width is larger than the space before that edge on narrow screens.
Its inline min-width of 340px also beat the viewport max-width below 356px.
Visually hidden text in the rows was positioned against the menu, so the menu itself could be scrolled and move its header out of view.
fix: Below xs (480px) the menu anchors to the end of the top-bar actions. The minimum width is min(340px, 100vw - 16px). The list is the containing block for its own rows.
method: Chromium, reduced motion, launchpad and invoice list, left to right and right to left, default and compact density, at 320, 360, 390, 480, 600, 767, 768, 900, 1023, 1024 and 1440px by 844px, with a pointer at every width and with touch emulation below 1024px. One reading is one state; the Direct and Email tabs are both read in it.
acceptedChangesBelow480px: The menu sits 4px below the actions row instead of 4px below the bell. Its top moves down by up to 9px where the bell is shorter than the row.
At 320px the menu is 304px wide instead of 340px, so row text wraps more and the list scrolls further.
notMeasured: Physical devices, dark and high-contrast modes
Interface scale values other than the default
